What is crowdNFO?

crowdNFO is a community-driven archive of .NFO files and MediaInfo data for scene and P2P releases. Users can submit and report files as well as comment on releases. Each user has a trust grade and once the combined trust of submitters reaches a threshold, a file is accepted as the canonical version.

You can automatically submit NFO and MediaInfo files by adding a simple post-processing script to your Usenet or Torrent download client. This makes contributing effortless - just set it up once and your downloads will be submitted to crowdNFO automatically!

On crowdNFO you can:

  • Discover releases and browse their submitted NFO / MediaInfo files.
  • Submit missing or improved files manually or automatically.
  • Comment on releases and discuss with other members.
  • Report incorrect files or comments.
  • Climb the high-score list by contributing quality submissions.
